literal: Resting upon those who possess goodness, the world exists; if that is not so, having entered the earth, it will perish indeed.
translation: The world endures because it rests upon people of noble character. If it did not, it would crumble into the dust and perish.
modern: பண்புடைய மனிதர்களைப் பொருத்தே இவ்வுலகம் நிலைபெற்று இயங்குகிறது. அந்தப் பண்பு மட்டும் இல்லாவிட்டால், உலகம் மண்ணுக்குள் புதைந்து அழிந்துவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes that the survival and functioning of the world depend entirely on people of noble character. The word 'பட்டு' indicates that the world's existence rests upon or is anchored by these good individuals. Without their sustaining virtue, the text vividly states that the world would simply sink into the dirt and cease to exist. The particle 'மன்' at the end adds a tone of absolute certainty to this inevitable ruin.
